problem: Bounded human working memory and rule-based long-term memory interaction.
contribution: Separated small active working memory buffer from large persistent rule base.
limitation: Symbolic rule brittleness, lack of probabilistic natural language representation.
relevance_to_manigit: Theoretical precursor to separating bounded context window from persistent long-term storage.

problem: Formalizing belief updates when new information contradicts existing beliefs.
contribution: Defined postulates for belief contraction and revision (Success, Consistency, Minimal Change).
limitation: Propositional, computationally intractable for large corpora, destructive of old beliefs.
relevance_to_manigit: Foundational logic for ManiGit contradiction detection and supersession.

representative_work: Graves et al. (NTM), Weston et al. (Memory Networks)
problem: RNNs unable to store and address long sequences of facts explicitly.
contribution: External continuous memory matrices with differentiable content-based and address-based read/write heads.
limitation: Difficult gradient optimization, bounded matrix size, lack of symbolic human interpretability.
relevance_to_manigit: Demonstrated that externalized memory is required beyond parameter weights.

representative_work: Vaswani et al. (Attention Is All You Need)
problem: Sequential recurrent bottleneck in long sequence modeling.
contribution: Self-attention mechanism allowing soft associative routing over token context.
limitation: Context window is ephemeral and bounded; memory disappears between independent requests.
relevance_to_manigit: Defines the fundamental context window abstraction that ManiGit compiles into.

representative_work: Lewis et al. (RAG), Guu et al. (REALM)
problem: Parametric hallucinations and inability to update world knowledge dynamically.
contribution: Coupled non-parametric dense vector retriever (FAISS/DPR) with parametric generator.
limitation: Designed for static documents; lacks state evolution, contradiction handling, and session provenance.
relevance_to_manigit: Standard baseline; ManiGit shows RAG fails on temporal fact supersession.

problem: Simulating believable multi-day agent social interactions across days.
contribution: Append-only memory stream with recency/importance/relevance ranking and reflection synthesis.
limitation: Unbounded linear log growth, lacks commit DAGs, lacks contradiction supersession.
relevance_to_manigit: Pioneered agent reflection; ManiGit adds formal commit trees, tiers, and contradiction handling.

problem: Fixed context windows choking long-running conversational assistants.
contribution: Tiered architecture: context window as RAM, external DB as disk, managed via LLM function calls.
limitation: Destructive in-place overwriting, high latency for multi-turn tool calling, no time-travel DAGs.
relevance_to_manigit: Direct competitor; ManiGit replaces destructive overwriting with immutable DAG commits.

representative_work: Deshmukh et al. (Mem0), Gutierrez et al. (HippoRAG)
problem: Multi-hop reasoning and personal preference tracking across disjoint sessions.
contribution: Hybrid vector-graph memory with user/session scopes; Personalized PageRank over entity graphs.
limitation: Destructive fact deletion/update, lacks git-like branch DAGs, no why-provenance audit reports.
relevance_to_manigit: Commercial state-of-the-art; ManiGit provides non-destructive branch isolation and Why Reports.

representative_work: Wu et al. (GCC), Shekar et al. (GitOfThoughts)
problem: Context bloat during long-horizon software engineering; non-auditable reasoning trees.
contribution: Agent-invoked Git commands (COMMIT/BRANCH/MERGE); tree-of-thoughts serialized into Git commits.
limitation: Requires manual agent tool calls, lacks automatic intake classification, memory tiers, or budget knapsack.
relevance_to_manigit: Primary novelty counterexample; ManiGit automates memory intake, contradiction detection, and budget knapsack compilation.

problem: Agents need long-term memory that preserves historical truth, handles contradictions, and fits strict token budgets.
contribution: Immutable message archive + versioned commit DAG + rule/judge memory tiers + contradiction supersession + greedy knapsack context compiler.
limitation: Evaluated on controlled synthetic multi-turn benchmarks; lexical retrieval in reference implementation.
relevance_to_manigit: The proposed architecture of this paper.
